title: It works - Kind of
body: App works well for the setup it has. I will say it’s not the best at modifying personal goals eg I only want to wake up at 7:30am consistently but it wasn’t easy to set that as the goal as it would automatically try to put me to a 6:30am wake up goal. I ended up manually changing each week to be 7:30am. Also find that there are a few ways it could be modified to encourage me to achieve more - I find it very similar to just using the note app to track my own goals. I would like it better if it can have a little game component for my avatar to fight or play etc that would be improved from my own leveling. Otherwise theme is good and I didn’t find it laggy or buggy. I don’t believe it’s worth the price but I am happy to support as I see the vision and respect the developers.

title: exceptional service
body: at first I didn’t really want the app I had bought a $50 year long subscription and then as I got into the app I realised I didn’t really like the way it had been set out as I’m already well into my fitness journey and it had me starting off with beginner things nevertheless that layout was amazing to be honest I stared at it for like five minutes and if I was at the beginning of my fitness journey of well-being it would’ve been perfect for me anyway I contacted rise a refund they responded within a day fully understanding of my situation they even offered a free year long subscription as they really thought it would help me in the long run not only that but they fixed my account as I could not get in and they even updated me on further improvements to the app that they will be implementing 10 out of 10 at 10 out of10 customer service 100% would recommend
